name: Alveolar epithelium
failures: Fibrosis, emphysematous destruction, cystic fibrosis channel defects, acute injury.

see.note: CT shows architecture; bronchoscopy samples focally. No cell-state map.

model.note: Alveolar architecture, once destroyed, is not re-formed.

reach.note: Inhalation delivers to airway surface; alveolar and basal cell targeting is inefficient.

edit.note: Inhaled mRNA and gene editing for CF are in early trials. Modulators treat protein, not cells.

verify.note: Spirometry is a good functional readout.

anchors: Inhaled CF gene-editing programmes, early Phase
